articles.title: Goldman Sachs, Citi among banks said to commit $270 million to stablecoin venture
articles.snippet: The venture, known as Project Faro, plans to issue a dollar-denominated stablecoin and is expected to be incorporated in the U.S.

articles.title: Bitcoin lags stock rebound in advance of U.S. inflation report
articles.snippet: Bitcoin slipped despite a Monday rebound in U.S. stocks, with spot ETFs losing $201 million as traders await October inflation data later today.

articles.title: Live news: Bitcoin falls to nearly three-month low after disappointing inflation data
articles.snippet: A rate hike in December appears totally assured now, with Fed Governor Chris Waller suggesting even a 50-basis-point move could be appropriate.

articles.title: An 11-year-old Ethereum wallet moved $4.6 million and dodged a scam set up in minutes
articles.snippet: Bots spotted a wallet from Ethereum’s 2015 launch the moment it stirred and planted lookalike addresses in its history, but the owner sent the money to the right place anyway.

articles.title: Mercado Bitcoin to resume cash withdrawals after $49M hack
articles.snippet: Starting next week, customers can deposit and withdraw money through Brazil’s instant payment system. Crypto transfers remain suspended.
